title: Flow Step Resolution
description: Resolves each step's screen reference to a ResolvedFlowStep with screen title and slug or null for dangling references.
signature: resolveFlowSteps(flow: RawFlow, screens: readonly RawScreen[]) => ResolvedFlowStep[]
semantics: Maps a flow's steps through the screens array so the Flow editor can draw titles instead of bare URIs, handling missing screens gracefully.
